title: Codex Review Findings
description: Structured output schema passed to `codex exec --output-schema`. Maps to yellow-review P1/P2/P3 convention. Shaped for OpenAI strict structured-output mode: every object sets additionalProperties:false, every key in properties is listed in required, and genuinely-optional fields are nullable unions rather than omitted keys. Constraint keywords (minimum/maximum/maxLength) are deliberately absent — strict mode rejects several of them, and the consuming jq in codex-reviewer.md Step 6 tolerates out-of-range values via its own fallbacks.

findings.description: One entry per review finding; empty array when nothing was found

title.description: Imperative description of the finding, max 80 chars

body.description: Markdown explanation of why this is an issue and how to fix it

confidence_score.description: Confidence in this finding from 0.0 to 1.0, or null if not assessed

category.description: Finding category: security, correctness, quality, performance, style; null if uncategorized

code_location.description: Where the finding lives, or null when it is not tied to a specific location

absolute_file_path.description: Absolute file path (Step 6 strips the repo root to make it repo-relative)

line_range.description: 1-based line span, or null when no specific line applies

overall_correctness.description: Overall assessment of the patch correctness

overall_confidence_score.description: Overall confidence in the review from 0.0 to 1.0, or null if not assessed
